senses.gloss: शिच् f. (nom. शिक्) = शिक्य, the cord or strap of a yoke or pole for carrying burdens, BhP.
सिच्, [cf. Zd. hincaiti; Gk. ἰκμάς [?]; Angl.Sax. seón; Germ. seihen, seichen.]
2. सि॑च् f. the border or hem of a dress, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.
(du.) the two borders or boundaries i.e. the horizon, RV. i, 95, 7
(du. and pl.) the wings of an army, RV.; AV.
3. सिच् f. = शिच्, a net, BhP.
सिचय m. robe, raiment, cloth, clothes, Vikr.; Kād.; Rājat.
